svg.title: Commute Impact — hypothetical location comparison dashboard
svg.desc: An illustrative dashboard compares weekday driving commutes for 46 hypothetical employees between a current office and four potential locations. It shows commute-time distributions, commute reductions and additions, and a summary of the impact at each location.
svg.text: ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIO · 46 EMPLOYEES · WEEKDAY DRIVING COMMUTE AT 8 AM
Employee distribution by one-way commute time
Change in commute time versus current office
Number of illustrative employees by the size and direction of commute change
ILLUSTRATIVE DASHBOARD ONLY · NO CLIENT, EMPLOYER, OR EMPLOYEE DATA
